verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own feature docs place chat alongside to-dos, card tables and calendars as tools inside each project, and explicitly say teams can chat in Basecamp instead of Slack or WhatsApp. That directly delivers chatting in the same tool used to plan work. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of chat capabilities (direct vs. group chat, threading, notifications), independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat experience.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: With Basecamp you don’t need Slack, WhatsApp, or another chat app. Just chat in Basecamp instead.
Add the tools you need (to-dos, message boards, chat, a calendar, card tables), then invite co-workers, clients, even AI Agents.
Make a list, or ten lists. Assign items, set due dates, attach files, even create subtasks.
